item.title: Local Football Players Tanner Kaufman & Jared Schultz A Part of UW-River Falls National Championship Run
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- Former Northwestern Tigers linebacker Tanner Kaufman and Northwoods/Solon Springs defensive back Jared Schultz are national champions. The pair and UW-River Falls claimed their first national championship on Sunday after taking down North Central 24 -14. The Falcons end their historic season with a 14-1 record. Categories: College, Sports

item.title: Girls Basketball: Duluth Denfeld Snaps Two-Game Skid, Proctor Tops Esko for Win Number 11
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth Denfeld girls basketball team was back in action on Monday taking on Two Harbors. The Hunters snap a two-game losing streak, defeating the Agates 61-45. Up I-35, the Proctor girls basketball team tipped off against Esko. The Rails improved to 11-2 after taking down Esko 71-36. Categories: High School, Sports
